title: The Intent.app Console: daemon logs and one-off verbs in one window, copied from Gtools
objective: Intent.app gets a Console that works just like the Gtools CMS Console, copied from ../Gtools, and Run Doctor writes its output to the Console. In hv's words, 2026-09-14: "we need a Console that works _just_ like the Gtools CMS Console ... quickly implement that by copying the ../Gtools console. Then when 'Doctor' is run, it outputs to the Console log." The trigger: Run Doctor ran `intent doctor` and discarded its output on a pass, so a clean doctor looked like a click that did nothing.
